verdict: Spend is up sharply; cost per lead spiked while won cases remain zero.
narrative: In the last 28 days, $3,597 in ad spend produced 23 tracked leads and zero won cases. Over just the past 7 days, cost per lead jumped 261.7% as spend climbed 55% while lead volume fell 57% — the combination of rising spend and shrinking returns is the central issue this period. The root cause is a set of foundational setup steps — including pixel/conversion tracking, landing pages, and ad verification — that are overdue and are suppressing both lead quality and our ability to accurately measure results. Those items are being completed now, and once tracking is properly connected, Google Ads data in particular will reflect true conversion volume. As the setup is resolved over the next week, you should expect cost per lead to stabilize and reported conversions to more accurately reflect actual contact volume.

watch_item.issue: Cost per lead spiked 261.7% in the last 7 days as spend rose and lead volume dropped — conversion tracking is also incomplete, meaning results are likely under-reported.
watch_item.fix: Overdue setup milestones including conversion tracking and landing pages are being completed this week; spend efficiency will be reviewed and adjusted once measurement is reliable.
